tickerText: [TENNIS] China Open semis Monday in Beijing: Novak Djokovic (32-0 in Beijing) vs Daniil Medvedev; Alex de Minaur vs Hubert Hurkacz after Djokovic beat Alexander Zverev 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 and de Minaur rallied past Andrey Rublev 1-6, 6-2, 6-3 • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open qualifying starts Oct. 6 in Cairo—Hania El Hammamy and Mostafa Asal lead the Diamond draws on glass courts at the Pyramids; Timothy Brownell defended the Charlottesville Open on Oct. 3 • [BADMINTON] Day one of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Team Championships (Suhandinata Cup) in Cairo—47 nations, nine from Africa, new relay format to 55 points • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Rate Las Vegas Open crowned five 1,000-point champions Oct. 4 at Darling Tennis Center • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash day two at Shougang Park: Darius Movileanu upset No.16 Hiroto Shinozuka; Manika Batra saved two match points to beat Bruna Takahashi; Truls Moregard and Tomokazu Harimoto among Monday's singles debuts

newsItems.title: China Open Semis Set In Beijing
newsItems.excerpt: Monday's China Open semifinals pair Novak Djokovic with Daniil Medvedev and Alex de Minaur with Hubert Hurkacz after Sunday quarter-finals that saw Djokovic extend his perfect Beijing record to 32-0.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Crowns Five Champions
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Rate Las Vegas Open wrapped Oct. 4 at Darling Tennis Center with 1,000-point titles in all five divisions after a week of upsets on the PPA Tour.

newsItems.title: Batra, Movileanu Spark China Smash
newsItems.excerpt: WTT China Smash day two in Beijing featured Manika Batra's 12-10 escape over Bruna Takahashi and Darius Movileanu's straight-games upset of No.16 Hiroto Shinozuka as the $2.05M season finale rolls on.

newsItems.title: Junior Team Cup Opens In Cairo
newsItems.excerpt: The VICTOR BWF World Junior Team Championships for the Suhandinata Cup began Oct. 5 in Cairo—the sport's second African host—with 47 mixed teams under a revised best-of-three relay to 55 points.
